This app is a good game, but only barely. It's not because Niantic are at all competent as designers or developers; the game's core concept is just so good that they couldn't ruin it if they tried (and it often feels like they are). It's a great way to get oneself out and about -- healthy -- but the experience is a blend of chill, low-key fun and boiling, caustic frustration. The monetization is fine, but the money players are spending clearly isn't going into improving the game.
